filed: 2026-11-23, definition-lead (writer agent), before any GPU run of this experiment; refiled before any run (card refiled by redteam-lead: ratio rule, K_copy, a measured repeat floor); amended before any GPU run (the stage-0 bar from the measured cross-device repeat of the CPU rehearsal)

settings.settings_source: states: E242's settings e62 (experiments/kstar_vpd_wording_a/results/predictions.json), the six E62 states at own size as E257's World builds them (not the scaled lookups). D: E257's D of each item (512 windows of E187's read half of the e62 group: copy windows, windows without the cue and far text, 3:3:2); the copy windows are those with the marker last and A once before 'A M' (experiments/head_edit/run.py targets: 206 of 512 on e62/copy_s0's D, E280 CPU dry run). K: E275's saved in_K (experiments/claim2_needed/results/large/items_e62-<state>.npz), unchanged. cache_batch: E268's (kstar_needed load_config). control: the state whose all-D pass stage 0 repeats. repeat_tol: an absolute tolerance on E_b, 10 times a measured repeat of the same pass on another device: the CPU rehearsal of stage 0 (2026-11-23, cpu-run, INPUT_MANIFEST_CPU, fp32) recomputed e62/copy_s0's all-D write pass and read E_b over E275's K 0.03761000357344997 against E275's 0.03761000378175188 (2.08e-10) and over E257's K* 0.039088030939439106 against E257's 0.039088031212285636 (2.73e-10; dd relative L1 3.8e-8); the larger times 10. The same pass on one device at half the batch differs by 3.5e-16 (the same-card floor, recorded in stage 0, not a bar: it does not cover a change of card). E268's transcription_rel_tol (1e-11) bounds a sum over saved arrays, not a recomputed pass. too_small: the card's floor. ratio: the card's refiled bar. The K scan for K_copy uses E268's settings (kstar_needed load_config: derangements 4, examples 64, seed 268, rows 1024, logit_rows 8192), commute.needed.needed_set on the copy windows only at the last position. too_small applies to K_copy

readings.E_b_K_copy: commute.stand_in.explained_share(num, den, dd, K and changed) with num, den, dd from one stand_in.write_change pass on the copy windows of D only
readings.E_b_changed_copy: the same over every changed variable
readings.E_b_K_all: the same from the all-D pass (beside E275's saved E_b_K)
readings.copy_dd_share_K: sum over K and changed of dd on the copy windows / the same on all of D (dd sums over windows, so the copy windows' share of K's write change)
readings.E_b_Kcopy: E_b over K_copy and changed on the copy windows' num, den, dd; K_copy by commute.needed.needed_set with x and x' both from the copy windows (E268's settings)
readings.K_overlap: |K_copy|, |K_copy and K|, and K_copy's by-derangement growth

rules.R0a: Stage 0 stops the job unless the do-nothing (F = M, E257's) has no changed variable, every dd exactly 0.0 and E_b over K exactly 1.0
rules.R0b: Stage 0 stops the job unless the control's all-D write pass repeats E275's saved E_b over K and E257's saved E_b over K* each within repeat_tol (absolute), with the saved arrays' length and changed set equal to this featurization's; dd's relative L1 difference from E257's saved dd and the same-card half-batch repeat are recorded
rules.items: descriptive (card). The filed rule is applied to E_b over K_copy on the copy windows only: rival A when the three-seed mean of copy over the three-seed mean of lookup is at least ratio and copy is higher on every seed; rival B otherwise. E_b over E275's K on the copy windows is reported beside it with no rule. On the mixed-D values (E275: copy 0.0376, 0.0399, 0.0362; lookup 0.0399, 0.0431, 0.0429; ratio 0.90) the rule reads rival B, checked in code

expected.stage0: do-nothing: 0 changed, dd max 0.0, E_b 1.0; control: E_b over K 0.03761000378175188 (E275) and over K* 0.039088031212285636 (E257) each within repeat_tol; the same-card half-batch repeat about 1e-15
expected.copy_windows: rival A: ratio of the three-seed means of E_b over K_copy, copy over lookup, at least ratio and copy higher on every seed; rival B otherwise. |K_copy| not filed; under too_small reads too small to read. Time: the K_copy scan 38,938 x 256 cases per state, about 280 s on an L40 (E278: 277 s per item)
